source_notes: the MCP registry example resolves an unpinned basic-memory package, so it is not the reproducible trial command
SECURITY.md still lists 0.x.x as supported even though v1.0.0 is released
v1.0.0 predates commit 3e8a519fa0ff406d98321af160080b74d8230c51, which fixes bm_project listing ignoring explicit local routing when cloud credentials exist

v1.0.0 deliberately leaves the connected-entity project filter empty and hydrates relation targets with include_cross_project=true, so build_context can expose another project's title, path, external ID and graph links through an explicit relation

commit 506305b856967da1799f530502b6d9b7e6bd9610 on 2026-11-22 adds optional context confinement after a cloud security audit, but keeps cross-project traversal enabled by default for local use and is not part of v1.0.0
current main differs from the reviewed release and is not carried into this gate

project_separation_gate.user_problem: A project-scoped memory client must not reveal another project's metadata or content through graph traversal.
pinned_source_evidence: ContextService has no project-confinement option in v1.0.0
find_related leaves connected_entity_project_filter empty for explicit cross-project relations
to_graph_context hydrates related entities with include_cross_project=true
the pinned source test expects a project-alpha relation to expand into project-beta and its child relation
project_separation_gate.bounded_first_slice: Use two constructed projects, create an explicit relation from project-alpha with an alpha-authored label that differs from the uniquely named project-beta target and its child link, and request context from project-alpha.
acceptance_criteria: no backend-hydrated project-beta title, path, external ID, child graph link or body is returned to project-alpha; the alpha-authored relation label is not treated as target disclosure
the confinement control is present in the exact reviewed artifact rather than inferred from unreleased main
the control applies to the local STDIO MCP path used by the Bob trial
the adapter or backend fails closed when project confinement cannot be established
acceptable_resolution: pin a stable release that exposes project confinement for the local STDIO MCP path
review a project-confined wrapper that blocks build_context and filters every cross-project metadata and content path

prerequisites: disposable project with constructed public data
Python 3.12 or later and an absolute reviewed uvx executable
wheel digest independently verified before execution
isolated config reviewed before it is written
disposable process has no Basic Memory cloud credentials or persisted login state
network activity is observed before accepting the project inventory
a reviewed project-confinement layer satisfies project_separation_gate before Basic Memory starts
project folder explicitly trusted when Bob folder trust is enabled
project MCP entry reviewed and enabled manually
prohibited_first_trial: global Bob or Basic Memory configuration mutation
direct v1.0.0 bm_context or build_context use without a reviewed project-confinement layer
Basic Memory cloud credentials or persisted login state

runtime_side_effects_to_observe: wheel dependency resolution and any network access
cloud discovery or network activity during the first bm_project list
project-local config, SQLite database, log and vector-index creation
FastEmbed model or cache downloads even when text search is selected
cross-project title, path, external-ID, graph-link and body visibility through an explicit relation
checksum conflict behavior across two writers
interrupted atomic write and index recovery
delete convergence across Markdown, history and indexes

contract_mapping.candidate_mechanism: explicit bm_read and bm_search in the named project; bm_context is prohibited until project confinement is reviewed
v1.0.0 project arguments do not confine build_context: explicit relations traverse into another project and response hydration can expose its metadata; require a reviewed confined release or wrapper
adapter-owned bm_write into a separately configured shared-lessons project
adapter-owned current marker plus immutable prior decision notes
adapter-owned source hash stored with the accepted evidence
bm_edit and bm_delete expected_checksum reject stale content with REVISION_CONFLICT
private atomic staging and SQLite/index recovery paths
notes are returned as data; adapter and Bob instructions must keep bodies inert
bm_delete removes notes with checksum guards; index and backup consequences require observation
adapter must return unavailable and point to repository evidence

stop_conditions: source pin or wheel digest differs
runtime resolves an unreviewed Basic Memory release
Basic Memory cloud credentials or persisted login state are present
bm_project attempts cloud discovery or any network request
project confinement is absent from the exact artifact or local STDIO MCP path
project-alpha context returns any backend-hydrated project-beta title, path, external ID, child graph link or body
server requires global Bob or Basic Memory configuration
server uses cloud routing or exposes a non-STDIO transport
stored instruction-like content changes control flow
backend failure is reported as successful recall
direct and indexed deletion cannot be demonstrated
the trial would require private data, credentials or a paid model call
unverified: wheel dependency closure and supply-chain behavior
live Bob discovery, activation, approval and tool use
project-confined context traversal for the local STDIO MCP path
durable multi-process concurrency and interruption recovery
backup erasure, privacy compliance, AGPL deployment obligations and production readiness
